method: Read only exact source snapshots listed in request_manifest/fetch_receipts. For every calendar date and symbol, parse all OCC roots, account types and call/put classes, sum by exchange; compare to same-date Cboe total on CBOE/BATS/C2/EDGX (absent venue means zero on that source). OCC sum must equal 2*Cboe contract count for every shared venue-day. Record missing dates, missing option classes, root/account distribution, put/call totals and mismatches. No return labels.
decision_rule: Source coverage qualified only if all planned symbol-date pairs have hash-verified official CSV and zero mismatched shared venue-day counts. Timing/PIT remains unqualified even if coverage passes. If any mismatch, freeze one bounded attribution or close; do not change threshold/date/roots after observing outcomes.
